caption: The drawing shows a detailed, scale representation of an armchair from three different views: top, front, and side, using pencil and watercolor. The chair features a high, rectangular backrest and a wide seat, both colored in a muted reddish-brown tone, suggesting padded or upholstered surfaces. The frame of the chair, shown in light brown, is illustrated with carved detailing; the arms curve outward and downward, terminating in a simple scroll and decorated with a leaf-like motif. The front legs and side stretchers are turned with a spiral design, while other stretchers and the back legs are straight. The upholstery is fastened with decorative nailheads along the top edges of the back and the front of the seat. The drawing includes a scale at the bottom, and a rectangular box in the upper right corner contains handwritten information about the piece: "Scale Drawing of Armchair, American, about 1700," with further notes on its location and reference number in the Metropolitan Museum of Art. The drawing is rendered on a buff-colored background.
title: Armchair
